title: Book Three · Chapter 82: The Bag Kai Hides
story:
Several more weeks pass. Spring afternoons grow warm, and Ronan's birthday is near.

On Monday, Kai comes into class with a large bag. He puts it under his chair at once.

Ronan looks at the round shape inside.

“New lunch?”

“Not yours.”

Kai's friend sits down beside him and pushes the bag farther under the desk. Both boys look very serious.

“Friday?” the friend asks Ronan.

“My birthday?”

The boy nods.

“Friday.”

Kai opens his book quickly. Ronan looks toward Anna. She smiles but does not explain the bag.

At lunch, the boys take it away. Ronan can hear them argue quietly near the door.

“You tell him.”

“On Friday.”

“I mean the mark.”

Ronan turns back before they see him look. Anna puts her bottle beside her lunch box.

“You are very curious today.”

“A bag keeps moving away from me.”

“It may need a quiet life.”

He laughs and opens his lunch. There are four days to wait.

That evening, Mum asks about dinner for his birthday.

“We could go to the dumpling place,” she says.

Ronan looks up. They usually eat at home.

“All three?”

“Unless you want to leave your father in the yard.”

Dad looks through the door. “I can hear.”

Mum smiles. The meal will be their birthday gift. They have kept money aside for it, and Dad finishes at the usual time on Friday.

Ronan thinks about the warm bowls and the tables near the open front.

“Yes,” he says.

After dinner, he finishes his answer to Leo. He tells him about the market morning and the yellow paper flower. Then he writes about the quieter five minutes at the hall.

Then he writes one question about Leo's school.

Ronan folds the fourteenth letter and sends it the next day after class. His birthday is still three days away.

On Thursday, Anna brings something small inside her notebook. She keeps it there while he gets his own books out.

“Another secret?” he asks.

“One more day.”

“A long day.”

“You have survived fifteen years.”

He smiles. She closes the notebook, and they go outside for lunch.

Kai is waiting near the stairs. The large bag is not with him today. He asks Ronan about the afternoon game as if nothing is different.

Ronan takes the ball and follows him to the grass. He can wait until Friday, but he does not plan to stand still until then.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

curious＝好奇的；dumpling＝饺子；keep aside＝留出、存好；survive＝挺过、度过（这里是轻松打趣）。

## 理解问题

1. Kai和朋友把什么藏起来？本章有没有已经打开、正式送出礼物？
2. 父母为生日安排了什么不同的快乐？第十四封信什么时候寄出？

## 读句子

**He puts it under his chair at once.**

拆开看：He / puts it / under his chair / at once.

他／把袋子放下／放到椅子下面／马上。
